sql:
SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type 
FROM bond b 
JOIN connected c1 ON b.bond_id = c1.bond_id 
JOIN connected c2 ON b.bond_id = c2.bond_id 
JOIN atom a1 ON c1.atom_id = a1.atom_id AND a1.element = 'p' 
JOIN atom a2 ON c2.atom_id = a2.atom_id AND a2.element = 'n'
